title: workspaces / Single-folder workspaces
content:
## Single-folder workspaces

You don't have to do anything for a folder to become a {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} workspace other than open the folder with {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}. Once you open a folder, {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} automatically keeps track of configuration, such as your open files or editor layout. When you reopen that folder in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}, the editor will be as you left it previously.

You can also add other folder-specific configurations, such as workspace-specific [settings](/docs/configure/settings.md) (versus global user settings), [task definitions](/docs/debugtest/tasks.md), and [debugging launch](/docs/debugtest/debugging.md) files (see below in the [workspace settings](#workspace-settings) section).
